hero.title: Artisanal Excellence in Every Bite
hero.subtitle: Experience the fusion of traditional craft and modern pastry at Lumina Bakehouse & Academy.

about.title: Our Artisan Story
about.content: Founded in the heart of the city, Lumina Bakehouse is more than just a bakery. It's a sanctuary for those who appreciate the finer details of slow-fermented bread and delicate French pastries. Our Academy serves as a bridge for aspiring bakers to master the timeless techniques of the trade.

items.name: Sourdough Batard
items.description: 48-hour fermented organic wheat with a blistered crust.

items.name: Honey-Glazed Croissant
items.description: Laminated with premium French butter and local wildflower honey.

items.name: Artisan Bread Basics
items.description: Learn the fundamentals of hydration, fermentation, and scoring.
